reason: Akumulasi laba-rugi (klasifikasi >= 4) dari 1 Januari sampai sehari sebelum periode, dalam mata uang dasar dan nilai asli, dikembalikan sebagai satu baris milik akun Laba Berjalan. Dipakai sebagai data source kedua template Trial Balance Custom (filter date[$gte]/date[$lte] laporan menentukan awal periode).
name: tb_laba_berjalan_valas
query:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT MIN(G1.d) AS d1
  FROM (
    SELECT dd::date AS d
    FROM generate_series('2000-01-01'::date, '2100-12-31'::date, interval '1 day') AS dd
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
),
pl AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(COALESCE(jv.debit, 0))::numeric(18,2)    AS debit,
    SUM(COALESCE(jv.kredit, 0))::numeric(18,2)   AS kredit,
    SUM(COALESCE(jv.debit_a, 0))::numeric(18,2)  AS debit_a,
    SUM(COALESCE(jv.kredit_a, 0))::numeric(18,2) AS kredit_a
  FROM g_jurnal g
  JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
  JOIN kiraan k    ON k.id = jv.account_id
  JOIN subklas s   ON s.id = k.subclassification_id
  JOIN klas k2     ON k2.id = s.classification_id
  CROSS JOIN per
  WHERE g.status = 'approved'
    AND NULLIF(regexp_replace(k2.noklasifikasi::text, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::int >= 4
    AND g.tanggal::date >= date_trunc('year', per.d1)::date
    AND g.tanggal::date <  per.d1
),
lb AS (
  SELECT k.id AS account_id
  FROM kiraan k
  WHERE k.code = '320000020' OR lower(k.nama) LIKE 'laba berjalan%'
  ORDER BY (k.code = '320000020') DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
hasil AS (
  SELECT lb.account_id,
         COALESCE(pl.debit, 0)    AS debit,
         COALESCE(pl.kredit, 0)   AS kredit,
         COALESCE(pl.debit_a, 0)  AS debit_a,
         COALESCE(pl.kredit_a, 0) AS kredit_a
  FROM lb CROSS JOIN pl
)
SELECT account_id, debit, kredit, debit_a, kredit_a FROM hasil ORDER BY account_id {andOrder} {limit}
